title: The website's Contact page is listed in the Space Pages list and opens its Contact form for editing

source.ref: Owner ask 2026-10-07 18:12 ('Contact should be a page in my pages list.'). LIVE-839 / LIVE-840 follow-up.

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-07. THE CONSEQUENCE: a Space website serves a Contact page (/contact, built from the Contact form block, LIVE-837 to 839), but the Pages list on /spaces/<slug>/manage/layout showed only Home and custom pages, so the owner could not find where that page is edited. THE FIX: when the layout has a Contact form block, the Pages list shows a fixed Contact row (no rename, move or delete) with a View link to the live website page. Picking it (?page=contact) opens the layout editor with the Contact form block selected and scrolled into view.

verify.cmd: node -e "const f=require('fs');const p=f.readFileSync('components/spaces/space-page-panel.tsx','utf8');const l=f.readFileSync('app/(main)/spaces/[slug]/manage/layout/page.tsx','utf8');if(!/<ContactPageRow/.test(p)){console.error('LIVE-843: the Pages list has no Contact row');process.exit(1)}if(!/contactPage=\{contactPage\}/.test(l)||!/focusBlockId=/.test(l)){console.error('LIVE-843: the layout page does not list Contact or open its form');process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails on main (no Contact row in the Pages list); passes once this lands.
